---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for the platform
title: "[FEAT]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "discussion"]
assignees: ""
---

## 💡 Feature Title
A concise title for the proposed feature.

## ❓ Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
*Example: As an Organizer, I find it cumbersome to manually copy equipment lists when creating an RFQ...*

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it should work architecturally.

## 🎯 Expected Benefits & Business Value
Explain why this enhancement is valuable for the target actors (Attendee, Organizer, Vendor, or Admin) and how it improves the platform ecosystem.

## 📦 Related System Modules
Check all modules affected by this proposal:
- [ ] Frontend (`frontend/`)
- [ ] Backend API (`backend/`)
- [ ] AI Microservice (`ai-service/`)
- [ ] Database Schema (`prisma/`)
- [ ] Real-Time Layer (Socket.IO)
- [ ] Documentation / Book Chapters (`assets/`, `docs/`)

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
List the specific, testable conditions required to consider this feature complete:
- [ ] Criterion 1: ...
- [ ] Criterion 2: ...
- [ ] Criterion 3: ...

## ℹ️ Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup references, API contract ideas, or screenshots about the feature request here.
